import nuka
from nuka.author import Scene, materials, morphs, surfaces
s = Scene()
s.add_entity(morphs.Ground(), materials.Rigid(friction=0.5))
s.add_entity(morphs.Box((0.15, 0.3, 0.15), pos=(0.0, 0.0, 0.15)), materials.Rigid(static=True, friction=0.5))
s.add_entity(morphs.Grid(40, 40, 0.01, origin=(0.1, 0.0, 0.34)), materials.Cloth.VBD(areal_density=0.2, friction=0.5, stretch_stiffness=5000.0, poisson=0.3, bend_stiffness=1e-5, thickness=0.002), surfaces.Cloth(free=True))
b = nuka.SceneBuilder.create('')
for e in s._entities[:2]:
    s._add_rigid(b, e)
s._add_media(b, s._entities[2])
b.save(r'${out}/towel.nks')
b.destroy()

import time
deadline = time.monotonic() + 120.0
while app.actions.run('solver.status')['caps'] == 0:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, app.actions.run('solver.status')
    app.update(True)

s = ${capped}
last = s['last']
assert s['caps'] > 0 and s['recent_caps'] > 0 and s['records'] >= s['caps'], s
assert last['sweeps'] > 0 and last['vertex_residual'] >= 0.0, last

r = ${caps}['records']
assert r and all(x['capped'] and x['sweeps'] >= x['sweep_budget'] for x in r), r

import time
start = app.actions.run('solver.status')['next']
deadline = time.monotonic() + 120.0
while app.actions.run('solver.status')['next'] < start + 300:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, app.actions.run('solver.status')
    app.update(True)

s = ${settled}
assert s['recent_caps'] == 0 and s['iterations'] == 512 and s['last']['sweeps'] <= 512, s
